title: Support for OpenAI's Responses API Image Generation Tool
body:
### Description

https://openai.com/index/new-tools-and-features-in-the-responses-api/

I recently noticed that OpenAI has introduced the Responses API Image Generation Tool. I think it would be a wonderful addition if this SDK could support this new feature in the future.

If possible, could you please consider adding support for the Responses API Image Generation Tool? I believe it would bring even more value and flexibility to the SDK, especially for users who need to generate images as part of their workflow.




### AI SDK Version

_No response_

linked_prs.title: feat (provider/openai): provider defined image generation tool support
linked_prs.body:
## Background

OpenAI offers [image generation](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/tools-image-generation) for some of their language models. GPT-5 model launch includes the latest version of this feature. Users would like to be able to use these models to generate images (see #6425 ).

## Summary

* add OpenAI built-in `image-generation` tool

## Manual Verification

- [x] run `examples/ai-core/src/generate-text/openai-image-generation-tool.ts`
- [x] run `examples/ai-core/src/stream-text/openai-image-generation-tool.ts`
- [x] ui test with store: true and multi-turn interactions
- [x] ui test with store: false and multi-turn interactions

## Tasks

- [x] implement doGenerate path with snapshot fixture
- [x] update prepare tools to support new arguments
- [x] move `detect-media-type` to provider utils
- [x] implement doStream path with snapshot fixture
- [x] stream: support tool calls when generation starts
- [x] stream: add tool results add the end
- [x] add docs back in
- [x] add ui example
- [x] enable no argument constructor call
- [x] investigate multi-turn error
- [x] rm file parts, update docs
- [x] revert `detect-media-type` move
- [x] fix bug in staticToolResults
- [x] rm changesets of extracted fixes
- [x] adds docs note re store: false

## Future Work
* support partial images for image streaming via prelimary results for provider-executed tools

## Related Issues
Builds on #7977
Closes #6425

Yes.  
This is an agent issue because it requests support for a new tool (OpenAI's Responses API Image Generation Tool) that would be invoked by an agent system, involving LLM provider integration and tool invocation, both core agent system components.
